replies.author: KooDaLord
replies.body:
And you are overreacting. Seriously, zeus states that he isn't crazy about your map in a total normal way, and you call him out. I simply am saying a warriors building skills are beyond avicus mapdev standard.

My opinions on the map:

-1 Mainly made by world edit commands, unless you actually put time into randomizing blocks, Too many random colors, no depth. No detailing involved, and lacks character. To make it better, I would suggest making wall designs, that pop out. 3D detailing makes depth which is what makes a map good. Also try not to go with such colors, as they do not compliment each other and rather look random. Try a subdued color like stone brick or those types of blocks, then have some color blocks that match each other, like green clay and light green. Or wood and green, etc etc etc...

replies.author: IcyCode
replies.body: This is NOT randomized blocking. I have specifically thought about each layer of it on how I want it to look and what should the gameplay be like. The one factor I think about now when I build a map is what the gameplay will be like. I no my maps don't always look stunning but I now hope that they play well. I tested this maps twin and it played really well. The design is deliberately like this and it won't work if it had parts coming out the sides. I no you guys think alot about detail and design but I think of unique gameplay which I do not think you and Awarrior do as much. That is what I hope my maps show. Btw I disagree that Awaarior is above the Avicus map dev standard as if he is above it why wouldn't he be one. I will leave with a quote from Evocal: "I instead encourage the map makers to make their maps better and give them some tips in how to improve them" That is what a good map dev will do. Not say. "I could make this in 9 secs with WE"
